text:
maya: Quick update — ran an overnight cross-family quantization sweep (GPTQ/AWQ/INT8/FP8) across three bring-ups: Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B-instruct, Qwen-14B. Collected MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, and our conv-eval set. TL;DR: AWQ 4-bit is the best cost/latency win for Mistral; GPTQ gives the smallest accuracy delta for Llama; Qwen shows instruction-following drift at aggressive quant levels. More below.

arjun: Can you drop the delta table and the hardware used for latency sims?

maya: Sure — ran perf on dedicated A100-40GB equivalent (dedicated-1 pool emulator), and a 8xV100-ish multi-tenant sim for latency percentiles. Results (first-pass, mean +/- sd):
```
model         | config     | MMLU delta  | TruthfulQA delta | HellaSwag delta | latency p95(ms) | mem GB | notes
Llama-13B     | FP8 base   | 0.0%        | 0.0%             | 0.0%            | 420             | 12.8  | baseline
Llama-13B     | GPTQ-8k    | -1.1%       | -0.6%            | -0.8%           | 310             | 6.4   | stable, KV warm-up penalty ~+8%
Mistral-7B    | FP8 base   | 0.0%        | 0.0%             | 0.0%            | 180             | 7.2   | baseline
Mistral-7B    | AWQ-4b     | -0.9%       | -0.4%            | -0.5%           | 120             | 3.1   | best cost/latency tradeoff
Qwen-14B      | FP8 base   | 0.0%        | 0.0%             | 0.0%            | 460             | 14.5  | baseline
Qwen-14B      | INT8-opt   | -2.9%       | -3.6%            | -1.5%           | 330             | 8.0   | instruction drift in conv-eval
```

leah: Nice. On the Qwen drift — is that hallucination rate or instruction-following score drop? Any examples?

maya: Mostly instruction-following drop. TruthfulQA had a small uptick in false confident answers for Qwen INT8. Example from conv-eval (paraphrased): user asks for step-by-step reasoning, quantized Qwen sometimes skips constraint checks and produces a confident but incorrect plan. Hallucination rate (as we measure it) +2.4% absolute vs FP8 baseline for Qwen INT8; Mistral AWQ +0.3%, Llama GPTQ +0.5%.

samir: You mentioned KV warm-up penalty for Llama GPTQ — what's the failure mode? cache misses? token generation slowdown?

maya: Observed 1) KV cache indexing is slightly slower in our GPTQ runtime path (extra shim around compressed KV blocks) and 2) at high concurrency the cache population has a higher variance which shows up as p95 increase. Small wall-clock penalty (~8% p95) on cold keys, amortized out after ~32 tokens. Snippet from perf logs: 
```
[2026-03-19T03:12:09Z] kv_lookup: hits=0.64, avg_lookup_ms=0.72, compressed_decompress_ms=0.18
[2026-03-19T03:12:10Z] kv_populate: samples=920, avg_populate_ms=1.4, tail_sd=0.9
```

arjun: For rollout: propose canary Mistral-AWQ-4b on dedicated-1 (low latency, mem savings) with traffic=5%, monitor: conv-eval passrate, hallucination delta, token error rate, CPU steal. If green after 6h -> 25% for 4h -> full. Thoughts?

maya: +1 on that. Also add KV-cache hit-rate and p95 token latency for Llama GPTQ canary.

leah: I'll own the Mistral canary. Will set up alerts for conv-eval drop >1% absolute and TruthfulQA regression >1.5%. @deploy-bot can you create the canary? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary job created: mistral/awq-4b -> cluster dedicated-1 -> traffic 5% -> monitors: conv-eval, truthfulqa, token-latency-p95. Job id: canary-2750001.

kevin: What about cost estimates? Rough per-token cost delta if we switch Mistral FP8 -> AWQ4?

maya: Rough numbers from our billing sim: AWQ4 reduces GPU memory by ~57% vs FP8 for Mistral-7B which lets us double density. Token cost reduction ~38% (model ops) before accounting for infra savings. End-to-end app-level token cost ~25% (because IO & orchestration overhead). Figures are preliminary.

arjun: For Llama GPTQ rollout caution: KV warm-up means chat apps with long contexts may see transient slowdowns. Add automatic fallback to FP8 after p95 latency >500ms for 10m.

maya: Logged: add automatic policy + canary tags. Also note: we saw one regression signal in HellaSwag on Mistral AWQ that disappeared after re-running with better quant calibration (more calibration samples). So calibration sample count matters for AWQ quality.

samir: Action items?

maya: 1) Leah to run canary + initial monitors (owns) — started. 2) Arjun to add FP8 fallback policy for Llama GPTQ. 3) Kevin to update billing sim with AWQ memory-density gains. 4) I'll run an extra calibrations sweep for Mistral AWQ with 5x more samples and post updated deltas tomorrow.

leah: got it. Will post canary dashboard link once live.

kevin: thanks all. small ask — can we add a short checklist for QA team to reproduce the instruction-drift case on Qwen? want a reproducible failure before we decide rollout.

maya: yup — will add a minimal repro and attach to the canary ticket. For now: focus on Mistral AWQ as the likely first win, Llama GPTQ is low risk but needs KV fallback, Qwen needs more investigation.

arjun: :eyes: love the plan. Keep updates in this thread.
